name: bubbly
description: Bubbly — a local-first AI coding agent with a desktop IDE and a terminal client

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:cli
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:frontend: npm run themes && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.desktop: npm run build:all && cd desktop && npm start
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && npm run icons && cd desktop && npm run dist
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../cli && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && npm run icons && cd desktop && npm run dist:win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:all && npm run icons && cd desktop && npm run dist:mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:all && npm run icons && cd desktop && npm run dist:linux
